team_size.description: Agents in the team (#178 C1); the scored batch and the Falinks arm use 2

outcome.description: run_invalid: a nested agent was detected (#178 C7); never replaced, the batch stops and asks

status.description: complete: every agent's final turn result (its first after an accepted ready) arrived within the drain window

agents.description: Per-agent turn result reports in arrival order; a late one carries late: true

drain.description: After the clock stops, requests are refused while the host waits up to window_seconds for final results

edits.description: Falinks arm (#204): per output form (content, replace, from), the ledger's accepted, stale, unreviewed, rejected and interrupted edits, host_refused (refused before reaching the ledger) and resends, with reasons; and reverted_peer_text, accepted edits that bring back lines a peer's earlier edit removed, for a manual check

regrouping.description: Falinks arm only (#134 Measurement); transitions equals the top-level field

proposals.description: Proposal count by action (Join, Split, Keep), then by proposer (engine, agent-0, agent-1)

agreements.description: Agree responses recorded across all proposals

blocked.description: Proposals that were ever Blocked, with every blocker

regrouping_handles.description: Accepted falinks_handle calls that covered or cleared a Regrouping event

regrouping_round_trips.description: Model round-trips (distinct assistant message ids) containing recommend, propose or respond

start_unix.description: The clock's start in Unix seconds, to the millisecond; start_utc is to the second

nested_agent.description: The first nested-agent detection (#178 C7): the Bash command or the foreign session; the run is invalid

replaces.description: Run ID of the infrastructure failure this run replaces

concurrency.description: Run IDs active in sibling shard batch directories when this run started and stopped
